rules.follow_up_question: Kya mitti kaafi din tak geeli rehti hai?
rules.recommended_action: Mitti ki nami aur drainage holes check karein. Agar mitti abhi geeli hai to bina zaroorat extra paani na dein.
rules.safety_note: Yellow leaves low fertility ya doosri wajah se bhi ho sakte hain.

rules.follow_up_question: Kya growing season mein plant ko fertilizer diya gaya hai?
rules.recommended_action: Fertilizer history aur plant ki growing conditions check karein. Bina zaroorat extra fertilizer na dein.
rules.safety_note: Fertilizer na dena apne aap mein deficiency ka proof nahi hai.
